complete_examples.text: Finally, stochastic analyses of the dynamic response and the vibration isolation performance of the floating slab track are carried out using the coupled vehicle–floating slab track system dynamics model.

Thus, the proposed model is effective and useful for evaluating the vibration levels in floating slab tracks with uncertain parameters, and for predicting the reliability of the vibration isolation performance.
